Updates `better-auth` from 1.5.4 to 1.5.5
Release notes

Sourced from better-auth's releases.

v1.5.5

   🚀 Features

  • oauth-provider: Pairwise subject identifiers (OIDC Core §8)  -  by @​gustavovalverde and @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8292 (6c09f)

   🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Pass user field through idToken sign-in body for Apple name support  -  by @​bytaesu and Copilot in better-auth/better-auth#8417 (d364e)
  • Add missing SubpageItem properties for docs-sidebar compatibility  -  by @​bytaesu (6bcd7)
  • Add icon prop to SubpageLink component  -  by @​bytaesu (95538)
  • Correct sign-in link to dash.better-auth.com  -  by @​bytaesu (058bb)
  • Restore features.tsx and align import with canary  -  by @​bytaesu (e5ebb)
  • Add suppressHydrationWarning to video elements  -  by @​bytaesu (8e0e5)
  • Preserve custom session fields on focus refresh  -  by @​jslno in better-auth/better-auth#8354 (2bd99)
  • Throw on duplicate email when autoSignIn: false without requireEmailVerification  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8521 (e3e66)
  • Add origin check middleware to password reset request  -  by @​jslno in better-auth/better-auth#8392 (497b1)
  • adapters: Restore deprecated createAdapter and type exports for backcompat  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8461 (eb848)
  • blog: Fix RSS feed link path, image path and blog date  -  by @​0-Sandy in better-auth/better-auth#8483 (67c6d)
  • cli: Resolve path aliases from extended tsconfig files  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8520 (11ef0)
  • client: Preserve stale session data on network or server errors  -  by @​bytaesu in better-auth/better-auth#8437 (9a229)
  • db: Use CREATE INDEX for postgres migration  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8538 (b9e54)
  • oauth-provider: Avoid fetch redirect CORS after login  -  by @​GautamBytes in better-auth/better-auth#8519 (c0366)
  • oidc-provider: Validate redirect_uri for prompt=none  -  by @​jslno in better-auth/better-auth#8398 (ff352)
  • organization: Handle multi-role users in invite and member removal checks  -  by @​himself65 and Copilot Autofix powered by AI in better-auth/better-auth#8442 (23f18)
  • prisma-adapter: Fall back to updateMany for non-unique updates  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8524 (3f16e)
  • sso: Handle bare domains in domain verification  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8369 (fb7a0)
  • telemetry: Use conditional exports to replace dynamic import hacks  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8458 (3ecd2)
  • two-factor: Wire twoFactorTable option to schema modelName  -  by @​himself65 in better-auth/better-auth#8443 (f4604)
